skills.name: Keyword pop
skills.description: The sentence is visible; each highlighted keyword slams in with a spring when the voice says it.

skills.name: Word reveal
skills.description: Words rise and fade in one after another.

skills.name: Character reveal
skills.description: Characters pop in one by one. Best for short words and titles.

skills.name: Typewriter
skills.description: Characters appear at a steady typing speed.

skills.name: Slide text
skills.description: Text slides up into place while fading in.

skills.name: Scale text
skills.description: Text scales up from slightly smaller with a small overshoot.

skills.name: Blur reveal
skills.description: Text comes into focus while fading in.

skills.name: Mask reveal
skills.description: A hard-edged mask wipes the text in from the left.

skills.name: Highlight word
skills.description: A highlighter marker sweeps across each keyword when it is spoken.

skills.name: Underline word
skills.description: An accent underline draws itself under each keyword when it is spoken.

skills.name: Number pop
skills.description: The number springs in and counts up fast. For striking statistics.

skills.name: Number count
skills.description: The number counts up from its starting value, then lands.

skills.name: Percentage reveal
skills.description: A percentage counts up while a ring fills to the same value.

currency.description: Symbol used when the number has no prefix

skills.name: Currency reveal
skills.description: A money amount counts up with currency symbol and thousands separators.

skills.name: Stat card
skills.description: A card with the number and its label slides in. Good over footage.

skills.name: Slow zoom
skills.description: Slow push of 5–10 % over the whole shot. The default way to keep a still image alive.

skills.name: Slow push
skills.description: Dolly-like push: slow zoom with a slight upward drift.

skills.name: Punch in
skills.description: Quick 100 % → 112 % → 100 % hit on a beat (the first keyword when spoken).

skills.name: Punch out
skills.description: Starts punched in and snaps back out to the full frame.

skills.name: Pan left
skills.description: Slow lateral drift to the left, slightly zoomed to keep the frame filled.

skills.name: Pan right
skills.description: Slow lateral drift to the right, slightly zoomed to keep the frame filled.

skills.name: Parallax
skills.description: Depth drift of the media, slightly enlarged so edges never show.

skills.name: Blur in / out
skills.description: The media comes out of blur at the start and blurs away at the end.

skills.name: Camera shake
skills.description: Short decaying shake of the whole frame on an impact.

skills.name: Document zoom
skills.description: Slow zoom into the highlighted passage of the document.

skills.name: Document pan
skills.description: Reads down the page: zoomed in, the camera travels from top to bottom.

skills.name: Document highlight
skills.description: Highlighter swipes over the key passages (timed ones keep their timing, others are spread over the shot) with a gentle push towards the first one.

skills.name: Source reveal
skills.description: The source citation slides in after the document has settled.

skills.name: Chart growth
skills.description: A rising line with a filled area: shows growth over time.

skills.name: Chart reveal
skills.description: The chart scales in and builds quickly. Works with any chart form.

skills.name: Bar animation
skills.description: Bars grow one after another; the last one in the accent color.

skills.name: Line animation
skills.description: The line draws itself from left to right.

skills.name: Pie reveal
skills.description: Slices sweep in around the circle.

skills.name: Comparison
skills.description: Two values side by side, the larger one in the accent color.

skills.name: Map zoom
skills.description: From a wide view, the map zooms to the location.

skills.name: Map route
skills.description: A route draws itself between places.

skills.name: Location pin
skills.description: Pins drop on the marked places with a spring.

skills.name: Country highlight
skills.description: Countries fill with the accent color.

skills.name: Business expansion
skills.description: Locations light up one after another across the map: growth of a network.

skills.name: Glitch reveal
skills.description: Digital glitch burst as the element appears. Reserve for real revelations.

skills.name: Flash reveal
skills.description: White flash, then the element settles from a slight zoom.

skills.name: Blackout reveal
skills.description: A beat of black, then the element appears. Suspense before a reveal.

skills.name: Zoom reveal
skills.description: The element rushes in from a large, blurred scale.

skills.name: Text reveal
skills.description: The statement is revealed by a wiping mask, word by word emphasis stays.

skills.name: Chapter card
skills.description: Chapter number fades in, the title rises word by word, the accent bar draws under it.

skills.name: Source card
skills.description: A source citation card slides in at the bottom left.

skills.name: Quote card
skills.description: The text becomes an editorial quote: serif, large accent quotation mark, attribution below.

skills.name: Lower third
skills.description: The on-screen label slides in from the left with an accent bar, and leaves before the cut.

skills.name: Full-screen statement
skills.description: A big statement fills the screen, words slamming in, with a slow push.

skills.name: Kinetic statement
skills.description: Typographic hierarchy: small linking words, large key words, the most important one the biggest ("THE real BUSINESS"). Words slam in one by one.

skills.name: Counter roll
skills.description: Each digit rolls like a slot machine and locks in place, left to right.

skills.name: Odometer
skills.description: The number turns like a mechanical counter: digits scroll continuously to the value.

skills.name: Depth zoom
skills.description: An accelerating dive into the point of interest: the image seems to open up in depth. For a detail that matters.

skills.name: Cinematic push
skills.description: A dolly-like push with a slight rise, smoother and wider than a slow zoom: the establishing move of a sequence.

skills.name: Document focus
skills.description: The camera moves to the highlighted passage while the rest of the page darkens: nothing competes with the proof.

skills.name: Redaction reveal
skills.description: The key passages start blacked out, then the bars pull away to reveal them, as the voice reads them.

skills.name: Ranking
skills.description: Horizontal bars sorted from first to last, growing one after another with their rank: who leads, by how much.

skills.name: Percentage bar
skills.description: The percentage counts up while a bar fills to the same share: the proportion becomes visible.

skills.name: Flight route
skills.description: A great-circle route draws itself with a moving point at its head, from the first place to the last.

skills.name: City zoom
skills.description: From the region down to street level on a real map (MapLibre tiles), landing on the place as it is named.

skills.name: Light reveal
skills.description: A band of light sweeps across and the statement appears behind it: a clean, warm reveal.

skills.name: Impact reveal
skills.description: The statement slams in with a white flash and a short shake: the hardest hit of the video, for a major revelation.

skills.name: Warning card
skills.description: A warning: red side bar and warning sign, the statement slides in. Red is reserved for danger and negative events (bible COL-02).

skills.name: Key fact
skills.description: The statement inside an accent frame, like a fact card to remember: calm, clear, no effect.

skills.name: Timeline
skills.description: A horizontal timeline draws itself; each date (the chart labels) appears as its dot is reached. For a sequence of events or steps.

transitions.description: Dip through black. Chapter or time change.
Next shot slides over the current one.
Next shot pushes the current one out.
